---
description: "Review Gajab automation, strategy, bug reports, AI usage notes, or demo readiness before submission."
name: "Gajab Review"
argument-hint: "Files, PR, report, or scenario to review"
agent: "Gajab QA Reviewer"
---

Review the supplied Gajab work product with a judge-facing quality bar.

Use:

- [Review checklists](../../docs/ai/review-checklists.md)
- [Gajab requirements](../../docs/ai/gajab-requirements.md)
- [Sprint memory](../../docs/ai/sprint-memory.md)

Lead with findings ordered by severity. For each finding include impact, evidence, and a concrete fix. Then include residual risks, missing validations, and a short readiness summary.
